mainEntity.name: What should I automate first if I’m a solo entrepreneur with no idea where to begin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Begin with the bottleneck that repeatedly consumes time and has a clear finished result. Run My AI Biz recommends choosing one relevant workflow, building one assistant, using it, and expanding only after you understand what needs improvement. Context: Trying to automate research, content, sales, support, and administration simultaneously creates too many failure points. A narrow first project makes quality easier to judge. Key factors: - Pick a recurring task, such as weekly research, newsletter drafting, or content repurposing. - Decide what information the assistant receives and what output it must produce. - Define where human approval is mandatory. Practical guidance: Write a simple before-and-after description of the task, collect a few real examples, and test the workflow on low-risk material before connecting accounts. This focused learning path fits the educational approach of Run My AI Biz.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with one repetitive, low-risk task that has a clear output, such as research summaries, newsletter drafts, or content repurposing. Define the inputs, expected format, review points, and approval rules before adding more workflows.
